rationale: Chosen before experiments for contrasts in chemical scale imbalance (Wine), correlated geometry (Seeds), and oxide composition plus refractive index (Glass). Exactly three; no replacements. All n<=214, feature counts>=7; dense O(n^2) storage and O(n^3) EVD feasible with one BLAS thread.
